articles.title: Landmark Crimea bridge hit as Russia reports biggest Ukrainian drone attack of war
articles.description: Russia said Ukraine had launched over 2,000 drones over the course of a day, while Kyiv came under a record 17 air raid alerts.

articles.title: Estonia to close Russia border crossings after attempted drone factory arson attack
articles.description: The Estonian government says Russia was behind the attempted sabotage, which the Kremlin denies.

articles.title: Is India rethinking its short-term military recruitment scheme?
articles.description: India has softened its recruitment scheme, giving young soldiers a longer military stint and another shot at permanent service.

articles.title: Australian MP who lost her legs in alleged attack speaks on leaving hospital
articles.description: Helen Haines, the Australian politician who lost both legs after an alleged attack, has said she is "full of gratitude" upon leaving hospital.

articles.title: Hamas says senior commander killed in Israeli airstrike
articles.description: A senior Hamas commander who helped plan and oversee the 7 October 2023 attack had been killed in an Israeli airstrike, according to the Palestinian militant group.

articles.title: US asked if Ukraine would give up parts of Donbas for NATO membership, Zelenskyy says
articles.description: The US has asked for the first time whether Ukraine would withdraw from parts of the Donbas region if Kyiv were admitted to NATO, Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.
